system.description:
Favoured weapon: Sword, Rapier

Granted power: Once/day: force a bargain to be honoured (Will save negates).

  • A creature that knowingly breaks it has Disadvantage on all rolls for 24 hours.
  • When your Smite hits, offer terms to the creature: it makes a Will save or cannot attack you until your next turn.

Allegiance: Lawful Evil, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Asmodeus in the World of Arneyan wiki.

Suggested vow: bind one soul to your service by contract (your god's Paladin oath on the wiki; the vow you swear is yours to choose).
